channel.title: Mythical Void — The Signal Log
channel.description: See what is newly live in Mythical Void: game stories, useful resources and honest release notes linked to the playable browser game.

item.title: The Signal Log can now travel
item.description:
The checked Mythical Void release log is now available as an RSS feed for people and a JSON feed for future studio tools—without requiring an account or email signup.
• Both feeds are built from the same checked source as the public Signal Log, so titles, links and media notes cannot quietly drift apart. • Every item keeps a clean mythicalvoid.com destination, its artwork or gameplay disclosure and no tracking parameters. • Following the feed happens in the reader a person chooses; Mythical Void does not collect an email address, account or recipient.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/updates/feed.xml
Media note: Branded sharing artwork built around a real gameplay capture; the complete layout is not a raw screenshot and no player information is shown.

item.title: The father-and-son story is ready to share
item.description:
Adults, press and creators can now share wide or square artwork explaining how an Irish father-and-son experiment with imagination and generative AI tools became a playable browser game.
• Both layouts use the clean mythicalvoid.com/studio address with no tracking code. • The background is labelled as AI-generated marketing artwork, while the framed first-contact screen is real gameplay. • No photograph, name or identifying detail of the child is used.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/#father-son-story-social-assets
Media note: Founder-story sharing artwork, not a raw screenshot. The background is AI-generated marketing artwork, not gameplay; the framed screen is real gameplay using a company-controlled test state. No player information, photograph, name or identifying detail of the child is shown.

media:content.media:description: Square Mythical Void founder-story artwork saying One enormous idea, built together, with the studio emblem and a real first-contact game frame

item.title: A real-space sharing kit is ready
item.description:
Adults, families, educators and creators can now share wide or square Mythical Void artwork built around a real game screen and a credited NASA Apollo 11 image.
• Both layouts use the clean mythicalvoid.com/nasa-space-science address with no tracking code. • The framed screen comes from the running game and clearly credits the NASA public image inside it. • The complete layouts are branded sharing artwork, not raw screenshots, and NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/#nasa-stem-social-assets
Media note: Branded sharing artwork built around a real gameplay screen containing a credited NASA public image; the complete layout is not a raw screenshot, no player information is shown, and NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.

item.title: Shared links now carry the right picture
item.description:
The Project Beacon story and other important Mythical Void pages now give social apps a clearer image, description and accessible image text when someone shares a link.
• The Project Beacon story now uses its purpose-built wide sharing artwork instead of a generic or easily cropped image. • Seven public pages carry checked image sizes and matching alternative text for large link previews. • Every preview keeps its clean mythicalvoid.com destination and the artwork-versus-gameplay boundary.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/story/
Media note: Branded sharing artwork built around a real gameplay capture; the complete layout is not a raw screenshot and no player information is shown.

item.title: Share the game from the first screen
item.description:
A new Share the game button now sits beside Play on the Mythical Void homepage, making it easier for someone who enjoys the idea to pass it on.
• On supported phones and computers, the button opens the device's normal sharing choices. • Where device sharing is unavailable, it copies the clean mythicalvoid.com address instead. • The shared address contains no tracking code, and the Mythical Void control does not collect a recipient or contact details.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/
Media note: AI-generated marketing illustration inspired by the creature system; not gameplay.

item.title: A new way to share the game
item.description:
Adults can now download a one-page Mythical Void card, print it or send it, and use its QR code to open the free browser game.
• The QR code goes straight to mythicalvoid.com with no tracking code attached. • The card includes one real Project Beacon game screen. • The large creature-universe image is clearly labelled as generated artwork, not gameplay.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/resources/mythical-void-play-share-card.pdf
Media note: AI-generated marketing illustration inspired by the creature system; not gameplay.

item.title: The Project Beacon story is live
item.description:
A new spoiler-light story page now explains the crash of Wanderer-77, first contact, six living realms and the choice waiting at the heart of Project Beacon.
• Six realm images come from the real running game. • The page explains why the guardians are restored rather than destroyed. • The ending remains for players to discover themselves.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/story/
Media note: Captured from the real browser game using an invented test state; no player information is shown.
